sections.heading: Purpose of this screen
body: The Plant Details screen is the central place to view and manage a single plant instance created by the user.
It combines plant-specific information, reminders, task actions, sensor readings (if available), and quick navigation tools related to that plant.
The selector is inside the rounded header and stays visible while the page scrolls. The header expands to show the selector and contracts on screens without one.

sections.heading: Plant information
body: At the top of the screen, the user can see the plant image, plant name, optional plant definition name, and assigned location.
Below the image, detailed parameters provided during plant creation are displayed, such as purchase date, notes, light conditions, orientation, distance from window, pot type, and soil type.
These details help contextualize reminders, readings, and plant care decisions.

sections.heading: Tasks
body: Tasks combines pending tasks first and the 10 latest completions below, without separate headings. Pending rows have action menus. Completed rows show a check, completion date and person; a vertical line connects only completed-task icons. Photos are not included, and undone completions disappear.

sections.heading: Plant-level actions (3-dot menu)
body: The 3-dot menu associated with the plant header provides additional actions related to the plant itself.
Edit plant → Share plant / Manage sharing → Change image → QR Code → Show reminders → Task Journal.
Replacing a photo removes the previous server copy after the new photo is saved. Removing the custom photo restores the catalogue image when one is available.

Drag the photo to reposition it and pinch or use the zoom buttons to change its scale. The fixed red frame approximates Plant Details, and the blue frame approximates Plants list tiles. Your framing is saved with the photo and is also used for shared plants.
The same framing controls are available in Change image. Press Save to adjust an existing photo without uploading another copy.

sections.heading: Plant Definition
body: Info → Plant definition. Use Info, Tasks and Readings above the overlapping panel. Info shows your plant details and, when linked, a separate Plant Definition tile. Readings shows the linked device values or a no-device message.
This view displays species-level information such as plant description, care preferences, traits, difficulty level, temperature range, humidity, toxicity, and growth characteristics.
Plant Definitions provide general guidance and should be interpreted in the context of the user’s actual environment.

sections.heading: Tasks
body: Mark as complete: closes the task and allows you to optionally add a note, helping you build a detailed care history.
Mark as complete / Edit reminder / Task Journal.
Completing a task may include adding a note, which becomes part of the plant’s care history.

sections.heading: Latest readings
body: If the plant is linked to a reading device, the latest sensor readings are displayed directly on this screen.
Supported readings include air temperature, air humidity, light level, and soil moisture.
This section shows the most recent values along with the timestamp of the last received reading.
Tap an individual measurement value or icon to open its history with that metric selected. Tapping the title or background of this tile does not open history.

sections.heading: QR code and quick access
body: Plant details → ⋯ → QR Code.
Scanning this code using the Scanner view redirects the user directly to this Plant Details screen.
The QR code can be saved to the device or emailed, making it easy to print and attach to a plant pot for quick access.
A Flovers QR code contains a unique, opaque reference to a plant, rather than its numeric database ID.

sections.heading: Important notes
body: When you save, your photo is resized and uploaded to private server storage. Only you and people with active sharing access to this plant can view it.
Predefined plant images come from the Flovers backend and may be AI-generated.
Sensor readings and care suggestions are informative and should be combined with the user’s own judgment.

sections.heading: Details of a shared plant
body: Only the owner can change plant details, reminder definitions, devices, pump settings or sharing permissions. Shared reminder definitions do not appear on the recipient’s Reminders screen. View-only access never allows task completion.

sections.heading: Postpone task
body: Only the plant owner can postpone a pending task. In Home or Plant details, choose Postpone task directly below Mark as complete in the task menu. Tomorrow, In 2 days and In 3 days fill the date field relative to today. You can also type a date in your profile’s date format or use the calendar. Choose a later due date, not a past date. Save changes only this task’s due date; the reminder’s start date and recurring interval are unchanged. Completing the task still schedules its next occurrence according to the existing completion-based rules.
